issues.location: count of accessibility relations on n worlds
issues.finding: The parenthetical explanation of 2^(n^2) opens before 'specifically' but has no closing parenthesis.
issues.proposed_resolution: Close the parenthesis after the displayed count in the target.

issues.location: finite partition of infinitely many worlds
issues.finding: The prose requires each partition class to contain infinitely many worlds, which need not hold. The construction requires only finitely many classes; individual classes may be finite or infinite.
issues.proposed_resolution: State that each class may contain infinitely many worlds while the number of classes is finite.

issues.finding: The setup says there is no accessibility relation, then equates Box B at w with Box B at some world. The subsequent proof infers B at every world from Box B in the quotient. That inference is sound for a universal accessibility relation, under which Box B at w means B at every world.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use a universal accessibility relation and the corresponding all-world Box truth condition in the target example.

issues.finding: The first membership assertion omits the argument p from V-star, although the valuation was defined as V-star(p) and the converse direction uses V-star(p).
issues.proposed_resolution: Write V-star(p) in the first membership assertion.
